  VALUES ('{{ $json['Run ID'] }}')

)

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO reads (sample_id, lane, conversion_ref, sample_project, kit_ref) 
  VALUES (
    '{{ $json.sample_id }}', 
    {{ $json.lane }}, 
    {{ $('Check and Update Conversion Record').item.json.conversion_ref }},
    '{{ $json.batch_source_value }}',
    {{ $json.kit_ref }}
  ) 
  ON CONFLICT (sample_id, lane, conversion_ref) 
  DO UPDATE SET 
    kit_ref = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.kit_ref, reads.kit_ref),
    sample_project = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.sample_project, reads.sample_project)
  RETURNING uniqueref
)
SELECT 
  '{{ $json.sample_id }}' as sample_id,
  {{ $json.lane }} as lane,
  '{{ $json.batch_source_value }}' as batch_source_value,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT uniqueref FROM inserted),
    (SELECT uniqueref FROM reads 
     WHERE sample_id = '{{ $json.sample_id }}' 
       AND lane = {{ $json.lane }} 
       AND conversion_ref = {{ $('Check and Update Conversion Record').item.json.conversion_ref }})
  ) as read_ref
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy;

parameters.command:
=# Değişkenler
OUTPUT_DIR="/staging/bios/qc_test/output"
SAMPLE="{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.sample_id }}"

# Önceki input değerlerini al
LANE="{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.lane }}"
BATCH_SOURCE="{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.batch_source_value }}"
RUN_REF="{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.run_ref }}"
CONVERSION_REF="{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.conversion_ref }}"
RUN_ID="{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.run_id }}"
CONVERSION_ID="{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.conversion_id }}"

# Log Data Op node'undan data_op_ref al
DATA_OP_REF="{{ $('Log Data Op - CES').item.json.uniqueref }}"

# Dosya yolları
MAPPING_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${SAMPLE}.mapping_metrics.csv"
COVERAGE_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${SAMPLE}.qc-coverage-region-1_coverage_metrics.csv"

# Mapping metrics
total_reads=$(awk -F',' '/^MAPPING\/ALIGNING SUMMARY,,Total input reads,/ {print int($4/2); exit}' "$MAPPING_FILE")
dup_pct=$(awk -F',' '/^MAPPING\/ALIGNING SUMMARY,,Number of duplicate marked reads,/ {print $5; exit}' "$MAPPING_FILE")
mapped_pct=$(awk -F',' '/^MAPPING\/ALIGNING SUMMARY,,Mapped reads,/ {print $5; exit}' "$MAPPING_FILE")
q30_bases=$(awk -F',' '/^MAPPING\/ALIGNING SUMMARY,,Q30 bases,/ {print $5; exit}' "$MAPPING_FILE")
insert_length_mean=$(awk -F',' '/^MAPPING\/ALIGNING SUMMARY,,Insert length: mean,/ {print $4; exit}' "$MAPPING_FILE")
hq_mapq_pct=$(awk -F',' '/^MAPPING\/ALIGNING SUMMARY,,Reads with MAPQ \[40:inf\),/ {print $5; exit}' "$MAPPING_FILE")

# Coverage metrics
coverage_uniformity_20pct=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,Uniformity of coverage \(PCT > 0\.2\*mean\) over QC coverage region,/ {print $4; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
aligned_bases_qc=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,Aligned bases in QC coverage region,/ {print $4; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
aligned_bases_qc_pct=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,Aligned bases in QC coverage region,/ {print $5; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
aligned_reads_qc=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,Aligned reads in QC coverage region,/ {print $4; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
aligned_reads_qc_pct=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,Aligned reads in QC coverage region,/ {print $5; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
mean_coverage=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,Average alignment coverage over QC coverage region,/ {print $4; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
coverage_20x=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,PCT of QC coverage region with coverage \[  20x: inf\),/ {print $4; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
coverage_50x=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,PCT of QC coverage region with coverage \[  50x: inf\),/ {print $4; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
coverage_100x=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,PCT of QC coverage region with coverage \[ 100x: inf\),/ {print $4; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")
coverage_500x=$(awk -F',' '/^COVERAGE SUMMARY,,PCT of QC coverage region with coverage \[ 500x: inf\),/ {print $4; exit}' "$COVERAGE_FILE")

# JSON formatında çıktı
cat <<EOF
{
  "sample_id": "$SAMPLE",
  "lane": ${LANE:-null},
  "batch_source_value": "$BATCH_SOURCE",
  "run_ref": "${RUN_REF}",
  "conversion_ref": "${CONVERSION_REF}",
  "run_id": "$RUN_ID",
  "conversion_id": "$CONVERSION_ID",
  "data_op_ref": "${DATA_OP_REF}",
  "total_reads": ${total_reads:-null},
  "duplicate_pct": ${dup_pct:-null},
  "mapped_pct": ${mapped_pct:-null},
  "q30_bases_pct": ${q30_bases:-null},
  "insert_length_mean": ${insert_length_mean:-null},
  "hq_mapq_pct": ${hq_mapq_pct:-null},
  "coverage_uniformity_20pct": ${coverage_uniformity_20pct:-null},
  "aligned_bases_qc": ${aligned_bases_qc:-null},
  "aligned_bases_qc_pct": ${aligned_bases_qc_pct:-null},
  "aligned_reads_qc": ${aligned_reads_qc:-null},
  "aligned_reads_qc_pct": ${aligned_reads_qc_pct:-null},
  "mean_coverage": ${mean_coverage:-null},
  "coverage_20x_pct": ${coverage_20x:-null},
  "coverage_50x_pct": ${coverage_50x:-null},
  "coverage_100x_pct": ${coverage_100x:-null},
  "coverage_500x_pct": ${coverage_500x:-null}
}
EOF
ps aux | grep '/opt/dragen/.*/bin/dragen ' | grep -v grep | wc -l

=SEARCH_DIR="{{ $('Add Bed Path2').item.json.PATH.replace('P:', '/pool0/kozapeta/Data_Consolidation').replace(/\\/g, '/') }}"
SAMPLE_ID="{{ $('Insert or Get Existing Read Record - CES').item.json.sample_id }}"

R1=$(rclone lsf "peta_sftp:${SEARCH_DIR}" --recursive --include "*${SAMPLE_ID}*_R1_*.fastq.gz" | head -1 | tr -d '\r\n')
R2=$(rclone lsf "peta_sftp:${SEARCH_DIR}" --recursive --include "*${SAMPLE_ID}*_R2_*.fastq.gz" | head -1 | tr -d '\r\n')

rclone copy "peta_sftp:${SEARCH_DIR}" "/staging/bios/qc_test/output/" --include "$R1" --include "$R2" --transfers 2 --no-traverse --buffer-size 256M --multi-thread-streams 16 --multi-thread-cutoff 50M --ignore-checksum --ignore-times --no-check-dest --checkers 1

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO conversions (id_source_value, run_ref) 
  VALUES (
    '{{ $node["Check and Update Run Record"].json.run_id }}-{{ $node["Merge1"].json["RUN ID"].split("-").slice(1).join("-") }}',
    '{{ $node["Check and Update Run Record"].json.run_ref }}'
  ) 
  ON CONFLICT (id_source_value) DO UPDATE SET run_ref = EXCLUDED.run_ref
  RETURNING uniqueref, id_source_value as conversion_id
)
SELECT 
  inserted.conversion_id,
  '{{ $node["Check and Update Run Record"].json.run_ref }}' as run_ref,
  inserted.uniqueref as conversion_ref
FROM inserted;

parameters.command:
=DIR=$(echo '{{ $('Add Bed Path2').item.json.PATH }}' | sed 's|^P:||' | tr '\\' '/' | sed 's|^|/pool0/kozapeta/Data_Consolidation|')
FILE=$(find "$DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.txt" | head -1)
CONTENT=$(cat "$FILE" | tr -d '\0')
LANES=$(echo "$CONTENT" | grep -oP '"lanes"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]*')
READS=$(echo "$CONTENT" | grep -oP '"required_reads"\s*:\s*\K[0-9]+')
PROJECT=$(echo "$CONTENT" | grep -oP '"project_id"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]*' | head -1)
# 1;2;3;4 veya 1;2 ise => 0 yap
if [ "$LANES" = "1;2;3;4" ] || [ "$LANES" = "1;2" ]; then
  LANES="0"
fi
echo "{\"lanes\":\"${LANES}\",\"required_reads\":${READS},\"project_id\":\"${PROJECT}\"}"

=fdfind "{{ $('Insert or Get Existing Read Record - CES').item.json.sample_id }}.*\.fastq\.gz$" {{ $('Add Bed Path2').item.json.PATH.replace('P:', '/pool0/kozapeta/Data_Consolidation').replace(/\\/g, '/') }}

=export TERM=xterm

SAMPLE_ID="{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.sample_id }}"
R1=$(ls /staging/bios/qc_test/output/*${SAMPLE_ID}*_R1_*.fastq.gz | head -1)
R2=$(ls /staging/bios/qc_test/output/*${SAMPLE_ID}*_R2_*.fastq.gz | head -1)

/opt/dragen/4.3.13/bin/dragen \
-r /staging/human/reference/hg38_3 \
--output-directory /staging/bios/qc_test/output \
--output-file-prefix "${SAMPLE_ID}" \
--enable-duplicate-marking=true \
-1 "$R1" \
-2 "$R2" \
--RGSM "${SAMPLE_ID}" \
--RGID "${SAMPLE_ID}" \
--force \
--enable-map-align-output true \
--qc-coverage-region-1 /staging/bios/qc_test/bed_folder/{{ $('Extract Parameters').item.json.bed_file_path }}
